title: Review, with a first-time note
note: The words as spoken, with each tidy-up quietly underlined, a count of small fixes, and a one-time note saying what was and was not done. Words come from the seeded fictional family Asha (the web build has no speech model, so a real recording never gets words).
text: Close Hear it Asha · 7 months Read it back We only fixed what got in the way of your words. Nothing added. Please have a read Got it We fix small slips, like "um" and repeats. We can also mishear a word or a name. Please read it before you save. Asha, today you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too. 2 small fixes Filler " um, " Repeat " you " Show exactly what I said Keep it word for word Sounds like me Not quite Private letters stay with you. You can add them to the book later. Add to Asha's book Keep private
